# Tanin Rahman

Product engineer in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Core developer on eight production
WordPress products at bPlugins, running on 50,000+ active sites. Owns the whole
lifecycle: Gutenberg block architecture, PHP backends, admin UI, security
patches, releases and WordPress.org support.
